summary: Crescent Energy filed an 8-K on October 9, 2026, disclosing an underwritten public offering of Class A common stock under its effective Form S-3 shelf. The company sold 80,000,000 shares at $12.50 each ($1.0 billion gross), plus a fully exercised 30-day option for 12,000,000 additional shares, raising total gross proceeds of roughly $1.15 billion. KKR-affiliated Independence Energy Aggregator L.P., holding about 7.9% of Class A stock, agreed to purchase 40,000,000 shares on identical terms. This is a routine equity shelf takedown, not a special situation; watch pricing pressure and overhang from the exercised greenshoe.
